title: CEG domain pack admission rules a JSON Schema cannot express
description: Every rule engine/config/loader.py enforces on a domain spec beyond field names, types, enums, bounds and extra-key refusal that DomainSpec's JSON Schema states. Hand-maintained; tests/unit/test_domain_admission_rules.py fails when a rule has no negative parity test, a test names an unknown rule, an enforced_by reference does not resolve or an existing_proof test is gone.

validator.verdict: exit_code 0 and one PASS result means every rule below held; exit_code 1 and one FAIL result (check native-admission) carries the refusing rule's message. Admission stops at the first refusing stage, so one run reports one stage; within the withholding stage every defect is listed in one message.
validator.runtime_equivalence: --complete --require-reviewed applies the checks the runtime applies to a published receipt-layout revision (load_native_revision). The default runtime loader (legacy spec.yaml layout, default settings) applies the subset whose runtime.default_loader is refused; operator overrides never relax --complete.

fields.id: Stable rule id; never reused or renumbered.
fields.stage: Admission stage that enforces the rule.
fields.enforced_when: Condition under which the rule is evaluated.
fields.validator.message_pattern: Python regular expression (re.search) the validator's FAIL message satisfies when this rule refuses the spec.
fields.validator.error_class: Loader exception class the runtime raises for the same refusal.
fields.runtime.default_loader: Verdict of DomainPackLoader with default settings on the legacy layout for a spec violating only this rule.
fields.runtime.receipt_loader: Verdict of DomainPackLoader with domain_pack_receipts_enabled for the same spec.
fields.runtime.operator_override: Environment variable that lets the default runtime loader serve a pack violating this rule; null when none exists.
fields.existing_proof: Other tests that already prove the rule (path::test).

rules.statement: The spec is a regular file reached through no symlink in any path component.

validator.message_pattern: ^(Cannot read native input|Native input must be a regular file)

rules.statement: The spec is at most MAX_SPEC_BYTES (5 MiB).

validator.message_pattern: ^Domain spec exceeds maximum size

rules.statement: The bytes are UTF-8 safe YAML with unique string mapping keys, no cyclic aliases, nesting depth at most 100 and at most 100000 alias-expanded nodes.

validator.message_pattern: ^Invalid YAML

rules.statement: The YAML document root is a mapping.

validator.message_pattern: ^Domain spec must be a YAML mapping

rules.statement: Complete admission runs only while every validation guard setting is enabled (domain_strict_validation, domain_version_semver_enforced, gate_spec_forbid_unknown_keys, gate_name_uniqueness, domain_undeclared_param_rejected, weight_ceiling_includes_unscoped, traversal_open_range_rejected, prohibited_factor_full_coverage, gate_role_exemption); a disabled guard is a refusal, never a weaker pass.
rules.enforced_when: complete admission only (--complete / --receipt; runtime receipt layout)

validator.message_pattern: ^Complete native admission requires validation guards

rules.statement: Every top-level key is a DomainSpec field.
rules.enforced_when: complete admission only (--complete / --receipt; runtime receipt layout)

validator.message_pattern: ^Complete native admission refuses unknown top-level keys

rules.statement: domain.id is a legal tenant id (the tenant-id grammar; no Neo4j-reserved prefix).

validator.message_pattern: ^Invalid domain ID

rules.statement: domain.id equals the tenant id the pack is looked up by (the directory name of a folder-shaped spec.yaml, or --tenant-id).

validator.message_pattern: declares domain\.id .*; the directory name is the lookup key$

rules.statement: domain.version is <major>.<minor>.<patch>-reviewed or -production.
rules.enforced_when: --require-reviewed / --receipt; runtime receipt layout; or settings.domain_production_stage_required in production (default off)

validator.message_pattern: ^Native publication stage must be reviewed or production$

rules.statement: domain.version is <major>.<minor>.<patch> with an optional -seed|-discovered|-inferred|-proposed|-reviewed|-production suffix (ASCII digits, no leading zeros).

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*is not semver

rules.statement: Every variable-length hop range in a traversal step pattern is bounded, at least 1 and at most settings.max_hop_hard_cap.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Traversal step '.*': (hop count must be >= 1|max hops \d+ exceeds hard cap|variable-length range .* has no explicit upper bound)

rules.statement: A gate declares only GateSpec field names as keys.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Gate '.*' has unknown key\(s\)

rules.statement: A gate operator is one of >=, <=, >, <, =, !=, <>, IN, CONTAINS, STARTS WITH, ENDS WITH.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Gate operator '.*' is not in the allowed set

rules.statement: A gate queryparam is a parameter name or a scalar literal.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*queryparam must be a parameter name or a scalar literal

rules.statement: A property declares items iff its type is list and properties iff its type is map; a list of lists is not declarable; map property names are unique.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*(type list requires items|type list declares its element shape|type map requires a non-empty properties list|type map declares its keys|items/properties are declared only|a list of lists is not a declarable shape|duplicate map property name)

rules.statement: Query schema fields and derived parameters are scalars, never list or map shapes.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*(query fields are scalars|derived parameters are scalars)

rules.statement: A calibration pair's expected_score_min is not above its expected_score_max.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Calibration pair: expected_score_min

rules.statement: ontology.edges[].evidencerelevance is a number, never a bool or a quoted number.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*evidencerelevance must be a number in \[0, 1\]

rules.statement: Node labels are unique and (type, from, to) edge signatures are unique.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*(Duplicate node labels detected in ontology|Duplicate edge type signatures detected)

rules.statement: Every matchentities candidate and queryentity label is an ontology node label.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*(Candidate|Query entity) label '.*' not found in ontology

rules.statement: Every ontology edge's from and to are ontology node labels.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Edge '.*' (source|target) '.*' not found in ontology nodes

rules.statement: Gate names are unique.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Duplicate gate name\(s\)

rules.statement: An exclusion gate's edgetype is an ontology edge type.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Gate '.*' references unknown edge type

rules.statement: A gate's named queryparam is a queryschema field or derived parameter (or its _min/_max/_start/_end base; a temporalrange gate may instead declare <param>_start and <param>_end). Checked when the spec declares any query field or derived parameter; otherwise ADM-DEFECT-MATCH-DIRECTION reports the unbound parameter.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Gate '.*' references undeclared parameter

rules.statement: Scoring defaultweight values sum to at most 1.0 in every match direction, with unscoped dimensions counted in each direction.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Scoring dimension default weights sum to

rules.statement: Every GDS job projection node label and edge type is declared in the ontology.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*GDS job '.*' references unknown (node label|edge type)

rules.statement: refnamespace is declared on node sync endpoints (targetnode) only.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*refnamespace is declared on node endpoints \(targetnode\) only

rules.statement: Every sync endpoint of a namespaced node label declares the same refnamespace.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*every sync endpoint of a namespaced label declares the same refnamespace

rules.statement: A refnamespace belongs to exactly one node label.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*refnamespace '.*' is declared for both

rules.statement: A node label with a refnamespace is written only by its own node sync endpoint, never by childsync or taxonomyedges.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*has a refnamespace and is written only by its own node sync endpoint

rules.statement: observedfrom, when present, is a non-empty list.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*observedfrom is a non-empty list

rules.statement: Both node labels of an endpoint that declares observedfrom declare a refnamespace on their node sync endpoint.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*observed node '.*' declares no refnamespace

rules.statement: A provider association (provider, fromobjecttype, toobjecttype, associationcategory, associationtypeid) is mapped by at most one relationship endpoint.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*provider association .* is already mapped by

rules.statement: An ontology edge that declares evidencerelevance is written by a relationship sync endpoint with that targetedge, fromnode and tonode.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*declares evidencerelevance but no relationship sync endpoint writes it

rules.statement: Every signature of an edge type that declares evidencerelevance declares the same value.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*every signature declares the same evidencerelevance

rules.statement: A relationship endpoint that declares observedfrom or writes a relevance edge declares targetedge, fromnode and tonode without targetnode, uses batchstrategy UNWINDMERGE, and names exactly one ontology edge that is DIRECTED and managedby sync.

validator.message_pattern: validation failed:(.|\n)*Endpoint '.*': (a relationship endpoint declares targetedge, fromnode and tonode|declares both targetnode and targetedge|relationship sync requires batchstrategy UNWINDMERGE|ontology must declare exactly one edge|edge '.*' must be declared DIRECTED and managedby sync)

rules.statement: A pack declaring domain.activation: dormant is withheld.

validator.message_pattern: is declared dormant by its pack \(domain\.activation: dormant\)

rules.statement: Every structural property a gate, scoring dimension or GDS job uses is declared by the pack (exclusion edgetype/candidateprop, geodecay latitude/longitude, community property, louvain writeproperty, geoproximity writeproperties).

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*undeclared structural property:

rules.statement: No gate declares strictwhen (no compiler consumes it).

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*strictwhen .* is not consumed by any compiler

rules.statement: No gate declares roleexempt or relaxedpenalty (match takes no request role and relaxed matching is not exposed).

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*(roleexempt .* is not consumed|relaxedpenalty .* is not consumed)

rules.statement: Every gate compiles to executable Cypher: the gate compiler accepts it, a traversal gate declares its edgetype (no RELATES_TO fallback) and every $parameter it emits is an identifier.

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*(: refused by the compiler|RELATES_TO fallback|is not an identifier)

rules.statement: plugins.inference_rules names only registered inference rules; inference_rule_parameters are declared only for authorized rules, are present for rules that require them, and are well formed.

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*plugins\.inference_rule(s|_parameters)

rules.statement: The typed sync contract holds: a declared map or list<map> is consumed by a childsync, and each node sync endpoint's idproperty, childsync, taxonomyedges and fieldsupdated fields are declared on its targetnode in a writable shape.

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*\((sync |ontology node |ontology edge )

rules.statement: A scoring dimension's null_strategy inherit_prior or cold_start_fallback structural_similarity has a producer: the pack declares candidate._prior_<dimension> or candidate.shared_neighbor_score.
rules.enforced_when: complete admission, or settings.scoring_admission_check_enabled at runtime (default off)

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*has no producer

rules.statement: Every scoring dimension compiles in each match direction it applies to, the direction's scoring clause assembles, and every $parameter a dimension references is bound by handle_match.
rules.enforced_when: complete admission, or settings.scoring_admission_check_enabled / settings.admission_checks_full_match at runtime (both default off)

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*scoring\[.*\]( .*)?: (refused by the scoring (compiler|assembler)|references parameter\(s\) .*, which nothing binds)

rules.statement: For every declared match direction the traversal assembles, the gates compile together, and every $parameter they reference is bound by handle_match.
rules.enforced_when: complete admission, or settings.admission_checks_full_match at runtime (default off)

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*(traversal\[.*\]: refused by the traversal assembler|match\[.*\]: gates refused by the compiler|match\[.*\]: gates or traversal reference parameter\(s\) .*, which nothing binds)

rules.statement: Every gate edgetype (any gate type) is an ontology edge type.
rules.enforced_when: complete admission only (--complete / --receipt; runtime receipt layout)

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*gate .*: undeclared edge type

rules.statement: The traversal validator reports no warning in any match direction (for example a step referencing an undeclared label or relationship type).
rules.enforced_when: complete admission only (--complete / --receipt; runtime receipt layout)

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*Traversal step '.*':

rules.statement: No gate and no scoring dimension references a field listed in compliance.prohibitedfactors.blockedfields.
rules.enforced_when: complete admission only (--complete / --receipt; runtime receipt layout)

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*compliance: .* references prohibited field

rules.statement: Every sync endpoint is accepted by the native sync owner: a node endpoint's targetnode and idproperty are declared by the ontology and its query generates; a relationship endpoint's declaration resolves.
rules.enforced_when: complete admission only (--complete / --receipt; runtime receipt layout)

validator.message_pattern: is withheld: \d+ admission defect\(s\).*sync .*: (refused by native sync owner|targetnode/idproperty is not declared by ontology)

rules.statement: A native approval receipt is a strict ceg.domain-approval/v1 record whose tenant_id, version, sha256 and reviewed_input_sha256 bind the exact admitted bytes, and whose previous_sha256 is not the revision itself.

validator.message_pattern: ^(Native receipt tenant/hash mismatch or spec tamper|Native approval does not bind exact reviewed input bytes|Native receipt version does not match admitted spec|Native receipt cannot refer to itself as the previous revision|Invalid native record)
